This template is intended to be used on talk pages to inform the Wookieepedia editing community of any consensus decision directly related to a media.

==Usage==
<code><nowiki>{{ConsensusTalkheader|issue=|discussion=}}</nowiki></code>

==Example(s)==
For the ''[[Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes]]'' [[Talk:Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes|talk page]]:

<code><nowiki>{{ConsensusTalkheader|issue=the game featuring characters from different continuities|discussion=[[Wookieepedia:Mofferences/January 6, 2019|here]]}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{ConsensusTalkheader|''Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes''|issue=the game featuring characters from different continuities|discussion=[[Wookieepedia:Mofferences/January 6, 2019|here]]}}
